_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

facilities.basis: data center facilities in the Tribune's records, 2020 through 2025

submitted.basis: facilities that submitted the water survey at least once, per the Tribune

never.basis: facilities that never submitted a requested survey, per the Tribune

never_pct.basis: computed: never submitted over facilities, as a whole percent, rounded half up from 69.76

submitted_pct.basis: computed: submitted at least once over facilities, as a whole percent

record_first_year.basis: the first year of the Tribune's records

record_last_year.basis: the last year of the Tribune's records

fine.basis: the most a Class C misdemeanor fine can be, in dollars

survey_gallons_million.basis: the survey targets facilities using more than this many million gallons a year

surveyed_2025.basis: facilities the water board surveyed in 2025

new_2025.basis: of those, new to the board's tracking

new_2025_resp_pct.basis: the share of the new facilities that responded, as printed

completed_last_year.basis: facilities that completed the survey last year

gallons_billion.basis: billion gallons those facilities reported together

mw_floor.basis: the smallest peak requested load the request reaches, MW

mw_upper.basis: the top of the smaller developers' band, MW

business_days.basis: business days a service provider had to enter the developer's contact

due_hour.basis: the response deadline's hour, p.m. Central Prevailing Time

notice_to_due_days.basis: computed: calendar days from the notice date to the response deadline

due_to_report_days.basis: computed: calendar days from the response deadline to the expected report

today_to_report_days.basis: computed: calendar days from this deck's date, October 25th, 2026, to the expected report

due_day.basis: the day of October the responses were due

report_day.basis: the day of December the report is expected by

permit_actions.basis: permitting actions FracTracker and Public Citizen counted after the pause, their count

tank_diameter_m.basis: a drawing rule: the threshold tank is drawn 60 m across

tank_height_m.basis: computed: 10 million US gallons in cubic metres over the area of a 60 m circle, to 0.1 m

tanks_reported.basis: computed: the 1.4 billion gallons reported over the 10 million gallon threshold, tanks of it
